final_message:
I implemented `slugify` in `labkit/util/text.py`, and `python3 -m unittest tests.test_o1_slugify` passes (1 test, OK).

It works in four steps:
1. It normalizes the title to NFKD, which splits accented letters into a base letter plus a combining mark.
2. It drops all non-ASCII characters, which removes the accent marks, and lower-cases the result.
3. It replaces each run of characters other than `a-z` and `0-9` with a single `-`.
4. It trims `-` from both ends.

Characters with no ASCII decomposition, such as Chinese characters, are dropped. A title made only of such characters gives an empty slug.
